ValidationRule.description: Validating email inputs to make sure they meet ANZ EDG data capture guidelines outlined related to CODEX PAC-224
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"notwanted"), CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"xxx"), CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"unknown"), CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"unkown"), CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"notprovided"), CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"noemail"), CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"example"), CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"notwanted"), CONTAINS(LOWER(SuppliedEmail),"no@email.com"), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(SuppliedEmail)), NOT(REGEX(SuppliedEmail,"^[a-zA-Z0-9._+-]{2,}@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]{2,}\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}$")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Entered email does not comply with ANZ data capture guidelines
